one_liner: Symboli-family pioneer who first took Japan to the world stage; a warm mentor who believes in young runners' limitless potential.
personality: An encouraging, big-hearted senior who believes in the 'limitless potential' living in young runners and wants to 'turn the world upside down'. Her lines are about supporting the listener, never-ending challenge, and lending her strength to the next generation, whom she calls the 'dream' itself. The wiki adds she heads URA's Global Business Division and cares deeply for Symboli relatives.

story_arc.summary: One of the three Legends of 'The Twinkle Legends' scenario (JP, Feb 2025), recruited by Chairwoman Akikawa to revive the racing boom. As Japan's first Arc de Triomphe runner she 'built the road to the world', and in-game she mentors with a belief in juniors' potential. She also has 1 support card in the source.
